title: A Page of the Tally
text: The harvesters go back down their track. The crater on the plain cools. Somewhere in the system something is keeping a tally of every report and every parcel, and now you have a page of it.

choices.label: Head home
choices.reply: The lander lifts off the sulfur. On the plain the harvesters wait for the next parcel.

choices.label: Stay a while
choices.reply: We stay and watch the plain. The next parcel is due after Engram's next report.

notes: onDone of drop-field. The Act 2 "Expedition complete" card: Return to Touchdown travels home; Stay keeps playing here (the Command Core lists every route).
